featured_reviews.name: Rupert Fernandis
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had earlier booked the banquet for my roce ceremony, also known as haldi. The entire process, from booking to the final payment, was seamless. Based on that positive experience, I decided to book the same place for my wife’s baby shower. Unfortunately, this time it was a nightmare.

They wouldn’t answer calls, and I struggled to get hold of the contact person for the booking. The management had changed, which should have been a warning sign. The booking ended up at a completely different location. I had booked the upper hall for our small crowd, as the lower hall seemed crowded. To my surprise, when I arrived for the event, they had shifted us to the basement without any consent. I didn’t want to spoil the mood at the entrance, so I didn’t say much, but it was unacceptable.

The event was supposed to start at 12:30, but they were still decorating the backdrop when guests began to arrive. They even changed the welcome drinks. I had to coordinate with the staff since the manager was busy with another function in the upper hall. It turns out the halls were switched because the air conditioning near the stage wasn’t working. My wife was sweating a lot due to the peak heat season in Mumbai. They pretended to fix the aircon, but it never worked the entire time.

Then came the issue with the pani puri vendor. He had a cut on his left-hand finger. Despite being told by his manager and me to wear a glove, he refused. I warned my guests, but it’s hard to stop us Indians from enjoying pani puri. Sadly, everyone ate it.

The only saving grace was the food, but the coordination, venue change, and overall management were disastrous. My first experience was amazing, but this time it was a horror show. I hope they improve.

featured_reviews.name: Shakeel Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
A small but convenient marriage hall located on quite busy SV Road, Mumbai near Jogeshwari West Local station. It has some rooms n roof top open lawn/ banquet of approx. 600 guests capacity. It can be partitioned for separate arrangement of ladies n gents. An impressive wooden stage set like film studios is popular here, but it is too narrow and elevated too much. Can be a problem for aged n big group to climb for blessibgs n photo shoots with newly wed couple.

It has Vallet parking in basement ground, but approx of 30 vehicles capacity only. As SV road is too busy, u can't park on the road. Its rooftop is surrounded by multistoreyed flats and some people may feel privacy issues, as from their top floors, everything is visible.

Catering is to be arranged from outside by host, n not by the banquet. So for the quality of food, u shud complain to the host.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Staircase broken at many places endearing safety of the people. Current stage built as a castle is complete disaster with no proper lights or focus. Stationed Manager is very indifferent or having lethargic approach towards the customer complaints or any other requirements.

Overall disappointed with the venue looking at the current situation. This was once the most sought venue few years ago. Hope the management will make a drastic change.

featured_reviews.name: Faiyaz Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rating: ⭐☆☆☆☆
This venue was extremely disappointing and not worth the premium pricing. Despite charging extra for so-called “premium” services, basic infrastructure was neglected—broken stairs, no proper entrance lighting, and a stage where the lights did not function at all.

The rooms provided for the couple were unhygienic and poorly maintained, lacking even basic amenities such as clothes hooks or a washbasin. We also paid a substantial amount for a name standee, only to find it placed out of sight in a corner.

Most troubling was the conduct of the staff. At the end of the event, they repeatedly demanded baksheesh, even though a significant amount had already been paid to the manager specifically to cover staff gratuities. This felt unprofessional and predatory.

Overall, the experience did not match the promises made or the price charged. I would strongly advise others to be cautious before booking.

featured_reviews.name: Nadeem Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience.
The entrance was dark with broken, dirty stairs, and the elevators were filthy. Stage lights failed during the bride and groom’s entry, ruining a key moment. The rooms provided were unhygienic—dirty furniture, and the groom’s room lacked even basic facilities like a washbasin and clothes hooks.
Despite paying extra for a standee, it wasn’t visible to guests. On top of this, staff harassed us for money due to poor management. Completely unacceptable for a premium venue like this.

featured_reviews.name: Saleem Sayyed
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hosted two back-to-back wedding events at this venue, and the experience was disappointing. Despite advance requests, basic facilities like cleanliness and water in washrooms were unavailable on both days. You can compare the washroom facilities with any public toilets available in slums. Cleanliness of entry carpets and chairs also left much to be desired.

The management showed impressive consistency in redirecting responsibility to the caterers for issues that are clearly venue-related. While there are enthusiastic stories about managing extreme situations like unexpected rain, arranging something as simple as an extra power socket proved challenging.

Advance payment is strictly enforced but fails to deliver on basic commitments. Overall, despite the lawn size, the venue is not suitable for more than 100–200 guests, if expectations around basic infrastructure, hygiene and accountability are expected as part of package.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited The W Lawn for a wedding and had a very disappointing experience. The location itself is a major drawback is it’s right on a traffic-prone road, making access chaotic. The lawn is decent, but beyond that there wasn’t anything good.

The catering was shockingly poor. The food was extremely spicy and oily to the point that it was difficult to eat. I genuinely dislike calling food “bad,” but this was honestly horrible. To make it worse, there were no spoons available, and when we asked, they brought a few that were unclean and even smelt bad.

The washroom facilities were pathetic .. looked like temporary tin structures and I chose not to use them, even though I had a long journey ahead after the event.

Overall, a very unpleasant experience. I would never visit or recommend this venue.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pathetic and highly disappointing experience at this venue during my brother’s wedding on 13th May 2026.

The staff was extremely rude and completely untrained in how to speak with guests. From the beginning itself, they kept stopping our entry with the band procession and behaved as if guests were creating problems instead of attending a wedding celebration.

One serious incident happened during a fire gun celebration effect. Instead of first checking whether everyone was safe, the staff started shouting aggressively:
“Stop this, stop this, what are you doing, this is a residential area.”
The tone and behavior were completely unacceptable.

The rooms smelled bad, bathrooms were dirty, and one bathroom was overflowing. Maintenance standards were extremely poor.

Another shocking incident happened during dinner around 11:45 PM. Guests were peacefully eating when staff repeatedly started saying:
“Kitchen closing, jaldi jaldi karo.”
People are human beings, not animals who can finish dinner in seconds. This kind of behavior towards guests at a wedding function is disgraceful.

The worst incident involved my Mami, who recently had a knee transplant operation. Since the hotel staff had switched off almost all corridor and passage lights to “save electricity” even though the banquet was booked till 5 AM, she slipped and fell badly.

Instead of helping or asking if she was okay, one of the staff members came shouting at us for “making noise.” When we asked why the lights were switched off, the reply was:
“It’s a residential area.”

Even the AC was switched off around 3 AM despite the hall being fully booked till 5 AM. The excuse given was that “people were roaming around.”

The manager’s response was even worse. When informed about the fall incident, he casually said:
“Accidents can happen anytime.”

No concern, no apology, no professionalism.

This was one of the worst hospitality experiences we have ever had. We spent a huge amount for this function and instead faced harassment, rude behavior, poor maintenance, and complete mismanagement.

Strongly not recommended for weddings or family functions unless management seriously improves staff behavior, guest handling, and basic hospitality standards.
